test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.**

The plan began to _______ once we all met to discuss it.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**jell**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "**Jell**" means to solidify or become firm, like a jelly.
 
• The sentence suggests that the plan became more concrete and organized after the discussion.
 
• When we say that a plan or idea "**began to jell,**" it means that the plan started
